readings_unlabelled.R1: Within one continuous arrangement, (meta)static pod-deliria and techno-immortalism stands beside Hyperborean or Wendigo mythology, while shallow seas extend toward armored fish creatures. Beyond them are missing time and alien abduction and enduring ideas, historical time and remembrance, followed by upland rain forests beside cosmic swamp-labyrinths. Further across the same scene appear crypt-navigation and the plane of the third-eye, then turbular erosion and the metallic ocean of the earth’s iron core. The elements remain in this exact order, joined only by direct spatial relations and continuation. Earlier elements remain nearer one another, later elements extend across the same scene, and nothing else is introduced beyond what was dealt.
